name: Boku no Taisetsu na Mono
original_name: ぼくのたいせつなもの
source:
Main character is hopelessly ill with many organs not functioning, but he still tries to attend school. He finds joy in watching local idol Yuko smile. But as young people get closer, Yuko reveals a terrible secret that's going to affect protagonist's fate...

[From [url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2019/11/vn-of-month-september-2005-gunjou-no.html]vndbreview[/url]]
